verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible server, a one-shot chat CLI and on-device apps. Because it ships desktop and mobile apps, an AI document workspace is a plausible feature to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions agent-driven document drafting or editing, an integrated workspace, or automatic saving of changes.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
